The brain of a Mentokyr possesses considerable psionic power, sufficient to  overwhelm nearby enemies without an external psi amplifier. Unlike psi amps, Mentokyr brains can perform multiple psionic actions per turn, and can still be used by a suppressed Mentokyr. They have access to the Mind Scorch and Mind Control abilities, which they can use against any target in the Mentokyr's meagre visual range.

Mind Scorch always hits its target, bypassing all armor and inflicting severe brain trauma. A single blast deals enough damage to knock many weaker targets unconscious.

Mind Control instead attempts to take control of an enemy unit for one turn. This is more effective at close range, and easiest against demoralized enemies with low Bravery scores.
